key_features: Solid Carbon Steel Build: High-density metal construction delivers long-term durability and rock-solid desk stability.
Mechanical Damping System: Holds adjusted tilt angles firmly in place without slipping over time.
Non-Slip Silicone Protection: Cushioned rubber pads on the cradle and bottom plate prevent scratches and surface movement.
Ultra-Portable Foldable Frame: Folds completely flat into a compact 120g profile for easy transportation in pockets or bags.
Universal Phone Compatibility: Accommodates all major iPhone and Android smartphone sizes seamlessly.
